title: Similar

options.explanation: Alike ✓ — means similar to each other and is especially common after linking verbs such as look, seem or be. Here, people looking similar to each other naturally take alike. That makes Alike the most precise replacement for this particular sense of similar.

Comparable — means similar enough in quality, value, size or type to be meaningfully compared. This is best when meaningful comparison of level, quality or value is central; it does not simply mean 'looks alike'. The decisive clue is that people looking similar to each other naturally take alike.

Resembling — means having an appearance, form or quality like a particular comparison object. This usually points from one thing to a specific comparison object and is especially natural for appearance or form. The decisive clue is that people looking similar to each other naturally take alike.

Same — means not different in identity, type or value and is stronger than similar. This removes the difference that similar allows and therefore overstates the match. The decisive clue is that people looking similar to each other naturally take alike.

Identical — means exactly the same and is much stronger than similar. This is even stronger than same: it implies virtually no difference at all. The decisive clue is that people looking similar to each other naturally take alike.

Related — means connected or associated and does not require similarity. Things can be connected without being similar, so this changes the semantic relationship. The decisive clue is that people looking similar to each other naturally take alike.

Comparable — means similar enough in quality, value, size or type to be meaningfully compared. This is best when meaningful comparison of level, quality or value is central; it does not simply mean 'looks alike'. The decisive clue is that similar sequences over time make parallel precise.

Parallel ✓ — means similar in pattern, development or sequence. Here, similar sequences over time make parallel precise. That makes Parallel the most precise replacement for this particular sense of similar.

Related — means connected or associated and does not require similarity. Things can be connected without being similar, so this changes the semantic relationship. The decisive clue is that similar sequences over time make parallel precise.

Same — means not different in identity, type or value and is stronger than similar. This removes the difference that similar allows and therefore overstates the match. The decisive clue is that similar sequences over time make parallel precise.

Equal — means the same in amount, value, status or degree. This is about amount, status or value rather than general resemblance. The decisive clue is that similar sequences over time make parallel precise.
